rows.definition: policy.LoopDepthRule: the compiled policy cap on a looped model's per-request recurrent depth (max_loop_depth plus per-scope overrides); the gateway clamps the resolved loop count under its default cap and stamps Source policy_clamp when it lowered the depth.
rows.distinction: A POLICY CAP on depth, not the model capability (MaxLoops) and not the per-request receipt (LoopDepthReceipt); a nil rule caps nothing.

rows.definition: capabilitymatrix.Capabilities.MaxLoops (wire max_loops): a model's trained recurrent depth, read by the gateway as the per-model loop capability; 0 or 1 means not looped, so requests forward byte-identical bodies with no vllm_xargs.loops.
rows.distinction: The MODEL CAPABILITY ceiling, distinct from the policy cap (LoopDepthRule) that may lower it and the resolved per-request depth on LoopDepthReceipt.Loops.
